conviction_note: Both distribution periods in play were pre-released by the 2026-08-26 forecast revision, so the only things this print can add are a new Aug-2027 DPU guide (which the company already sketched in its own slide, so it nets to about zero) and a possible unit buyback. A buyback was announced at both prior August-period results (2024-10-17 and 2025-10-17) and the price now sits about 21% below the last programme's average cost, so I lean slightly positive: findings sum +0.30, scaled +0.13 (p_up 55 on abs 1.3).
bar: Company forecast as revised on 2026-08-26: Aug-2026 period DPU 3,070 yen (operating profit 14,083m), Feb-2027 period DPU 3,150 yen; the 2026-09-18 Urawa acquisition notice says the Feb-2027 forecast is unchanged. https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260826/140120260825525749.pdf . No IFIS or 四季報 consensus found for this J-REIT, so the bar is the company's own pre-released number.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), change 0.0 pts as of 2026-10-16 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the sealed baseline). Margin ratio 信用倍率 185, so margin longs far outnumber margin shorts: a crowded retail long, scraped from a broker portal. No options, so no skew. Baseline priced_lean_pct is -0.87, almost all of it margin overhang. 20-day run-up -5.21%, in line with the TSE REIT ETF 1343, which fell from 1959.5 on 2026-08-27 to 1814 on 2026-10-19 (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/1343.T?range=3y&interval=1d).

findings.finding: A unit buyback is plausible in the same results batch. 自己投資口取得 decisions came out with the results on 2024-04-16, 2024-10-17 and 2025-10-17, so at both of the last two August-period prints. The April 2026 deck says buybacks continue if the price stays low for long (投資口価格が低位長期化する場合は、自己投資口の取得を継続). The price now (109,100 yen) is about 21% below the roughly 138,250 yen average cost of the Oct-Dec 2025 programme (7.0bn yen for 50,633 units) and about 0.69x the 159,205 yen per-unit NAV. Cash and deposits were 31.8bn yen at end-Feb 2026.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Next-day moves after past results, from Yahoo daily closes, against the REIT ETF 1343 over the same day. Buyback prints: 2024-04-16 +2.16% (ETF +0.62), 2024-10-17 +0.39% (ETF +0.05), 2025-10-17 +1.24% (ETF +0.67), so about +0.8 points of excess on average. Non-buyback prints: 2025-04-16 +0.42% (sponsor bought more units that day; ETF 0.00), 2026-04-16 -1.29% (ETF -0.74).
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing has been announced, and the decision is made at the results board meeting. If the market had fully priced a buyback, the unit would not have tracked the sector down 5% into the print while trading at about 0.69x NAV. J-REIT buybacks are now a familiar move, so part of it is expected, which is why this finding is about 0.4 and not the full +1 to +1.5 a surprise programme bought before.
findings.independence: The buyback dates come from a different document, the April 2026 決算短信 unit-count history (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260416/140120260415504781.pdf). Kabutan's disclosure archive lists the 2024-10-17 and 2025-10-17 buyback decisions in the results batch (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8984&nmode=3&date=20251000). Against it: capital is going into acquisitions (MIMARU 11.5bn, Urawa 9.5bn, Amanek Kumamoto), LTV is about 45.5% against a target of around 45%, and the deck ranks a buyback against the DPU effect of buying property.

findings.finding: The reported Aug-2026 period was pre-released on 2026-08-26: DPU forecast raised from 2,920 to 3,070 yen and operating profit from 13,399m to 14,083m, including a 764m yen gain on the Naha sale. Feb-2027 was also raised, to 3,150 yen, and the Urawa acquisition notice says that forecast is unchanged.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-26 revision, released at 16:00, was followed by -0.33% the next day against an ETF +0.15%, so the raise itself bought nothing.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it has been public for seven weeks. It is filed so the reader knows the period is pre-released, and it is sized at 0.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-18 Urawa notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260918/140120260918538506.pdf) states the impact on the Feb-2027 forecast is minor and the forecast is unchanged.

findings.finding: The new Aug-2027 period DPU guide, a first guide, will probably step down from Feb-2027's 3,150 yen. Feb-2027 carries about 1,431m yen (about 315 yen per unit) of sale gains, while the company's 8/26 slide shows only about 172 yen of Naha sale gain for Aug 2027 on a cruise path toward 3,025 by Aug 2028. Rising funding costs are a further headwind: new 3-year bonds priced at 2.490% on 2026-10-02.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2026-04-16 print, which carried the new Feb-2027 guide of 2,950 yen and no buyback, the next day was -1.29% against an ETF -0.74%. No other new-period-guide surprise could be isolated.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced: the company drew the sale-gain path itself. What is not known is the cruise DPU and the interest-cost assumption for Aug 2027. If the market expected a cut, there would be no sell-side note; there is none, so this stays small.
findings.independence: Bond pricing notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261002/140120261002545205.pdf): 2.490% coupon. The April 2026 deck budgets interest-cost increases at about -90 yen against the DPU target.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: already done on 2026-08-26, so a further Feb-2027 change is unlikely (the Urawa notice says the impact is minor). Returns: a buyback was announced at both prior August-period prints, the price is far below the last programme's cost, and cash exists, so a buyback is possible, perhaps 50-60%. New-period guide: first Aug-2027 DPU guide, likely below 3,150 because sale gains fall, as the company's own slide shows. The quarter: pre-released to the million yen, so 進捗率 does not apply.
baseline_tension: The baseline leans negative (-0.87, from the margin overhang with 信用倍率 at 185) and the run-up is -5.2%, in line with the sector. My one positive, a possible buyback, cuts against that. The strongest positive this release could carry is that buyback, and I looked for it. The guide step-down is the main negative and it is largely telegraphed, so the net is a small positive.
lessons_applied: Open question 3 (a prior 業績予想の修正 may kill the event; one name moved +0.13%): the pre-released reported-period finding cut from +0.1 to 0.0.

Rule 1 (a negative resting on a series the market already has): the Aug-2027 guide negative rests on the company's own public slide, so it was cut from -0.2 to -0.1. p_up stays 55 because the lean is driven by the buyback, not by that negative.
Rule 2 (check for the positive): done. The buyback is the strongest positive and it is filed. The sum of +0.30 is unchanged by these two offsetting edits, and the scaled number is unchanged at +0.13.
